faq.headline: Frequently asked.
faq.q1: How is Libo different from other fitness apps?
faq.a1: Libo combines a massive exercise library, structured programs, progress tracking, and real cash challenges in one app — with a premium dark UI that stays out of your way. No ads, no clutter. Most apps promise motivation; Libo literally pays cash for consistency.
faq.q2: How do the Cash Challenges work?
faq.a2: Join a 30-day challenge (e.g. 100 reps daily), record yourself completing the reps each day — verified in-app, no way to cheat it — and cash out real money when you finish. Spots are limited, and your 30 days start the moment you join.
faq.a3: Libo offers a free tier with access to workouts, exercises, basic tracking, an activity streak and points, and an entry-level cash challenge. Premium unlocks the full library, advanced analytics, a freeze token for every challenge, and the €15 and €50 challenge tiers.
faq.a4: None — or everything. Libo has 396 home exercises (most need no equipment) and 432 gym exercises, including 50 mobility moves. Filter by what you have available.
faq.q5: Can I build my own workouts?
faq.a5: Yes. The Custom Builder lets you pick from the full exercise library, set your own sets, reps, and rest times, then save and reuse your workouts anytime.
faq.a6: Not yet. Libo is iOS first and Android is on the roadmap with no date yet. Join the waitlist and we’ll tell you the moment it lands.
faq.a7: Yes. Libo includes multi-week programs designed for specific goals — muscle building, fat loss, mobility, and more. Follow the plan, log your progress, and see real results.
faq.a8: Every set, rep, and weight is logged. Libo tracks your workout history, personal records, streaks, and shows your progress over time with clear charts.

why.imgAlt: Noah F., founder of Libo, carrying two friends on his arms

pillars.title: Forged in Leistungssport
pillars.body: Noah comes from high-performance sport: years of Regionalliga football in Germany, selected for the DFB Stützpunkt and the Westfalenauswahl with Bonner SC. Discipline held because something real was always on the line — a squad, a selection, a season. Libo rebuilds those stakes for everyone else.

pillars.title: One step back, two steps ahead
pillars.body: Off the pitch, Noah built two successful companies — the fashion label Mieuxnoir and the fashion production company Manufactnow. But life set him back a step more than once: wrong calls, hard restarts. Every time, he came back two steps ahead. That's the pattern Libo rewards — not perfection, the comeback.

pillars.title: Standards beat motivation
pillars.body: Willpower fades; standards hold. Libo turns training into a commitment you keep in front of others: public streaks, small cohorts, a club that notices when you don't show up.

pillars.title: A club, not an audience
pillars.body: No coaches or influencers selling courses — whoever joins the club later, members get everything through Premium. Cohorts stay small, streaks are public, and members hold each other to it. The product is the people showing up — the app just keeps score.

boilerplate.title: About Libo
boilerplate.body: Libo is a training club that pays members real cash for consistency. Alongside a library of 820+ exercises, 140 workouts, and generated training plans, Libo runs 30-day money challenges: members hit a daily rep target, record the proof, and cash out €5–€50 at the end of the cycle. The recording stays on your device and sharing is always optional — it is never a condition of being paid. Libo launches on iOS with a free tier and a Premium subscription at €79.99/year.
boilerplate.founderBio: Noah comes from German high-performance sport — years of Regionalliga football, with selections for the DFB Stützpunkt and the Westfalenauswahl with Bonner SC. scam.q: Is this a scam? Why would an app pay me?
scam.a: Your payout is set aside in cash the moment you join — funded by Libo, never dependent on other members failing. No draw, no luck: complete the work, get paid.

pay.q: Do I have to pay to enter?
pay.a: "Free money" — too good to be true?

tooGood.a: Most people do not finish 30 days straight. That is the whole point: the money is what makes the last ten days survivable, and it is funded by Libo either way.

miss.q: What happens if I miss a day?
miss.a: A freeze token covers it — Premium includes 1 per challenge, and everyone, free or paying, can earn a second by training 60 of the last 90 days. Out of tokens, a missed day ends the run — that is what makes finishing worth money. You can join again when a spot opens.

equipment.a: No. Every challenge movement is bodyweight — pushups, squats, mountain climbers, burpees and the rest. You pick which one you are doing each day.

when.q: When do I get the money?
when.a: After day 30 clears verification. It is paid as real cash — no points, no gift cards, no store credit.

free.a: Yes — the free tier gets you the core workout and exercise library, basic progress tracking, your activity streak and points, and the entry-level €5 cash challenge. Premium unlocks the full library, advanced analytics, cash challenges up to €50, and a freeze token for every challenge.

challenges.q: How do the cash challenges work?
challenges.a: Pick a challenge and hit its daily rep target for 30 days. You record each session in the app, so the run is verified — there is no way to fake it. Your 30 days start the moment you join, and finishing pays out in real cash. Premium unlocks the bigger tiers; spots are limited and first come, first served.

monthlyPrice.a: Premium is billed yearly at €79.99, which works out to €6.67 per month. Prefer to stay flexible? Month-to-month is €12.99. Founding Members lock the first year at €39.50 — about €3.29/mo.

03.body: Willpower fades; standards hold. Libo turns training into a commitment with real stakes: a streak that never resets to zero, and cash challenges where finishing is worth real money.
03.title: Standards beat motivation

04.body: No coaches or influencers selling courses — members get everything through membership. The product is the people showing up, day after day — the app just keeps score and pays the receipts.

01.body: Libo's DNA is competition and self-improvement — becoming the best version of yourself, in training and everywhere else. Consistency is what carries you there, and it holds when something real is on the line. Libo builds those stakes into everyday training.

02.title: Built to finish
02.body: Off the pitch, Noah built two successful companies — the fashion label Mieuxnoir and the fashion production company Manufactnow. Every venture demanded the same thing sport did: showing up daily, holding the standard, finishing what he started. That’s the pattern Libo rewards — consistency that compounds.
